 Fortnite Update 43.10 Early Patch Notes: New Sprites, Festival Season 16, and More

 In Short 
 Fortnite 43.10 patch is the first major update for Treasure Hunters Mini Season.
 The first major update for Fortnite Treasure Hunters Mini Season introduces new Sprites, minor map changes, and new Captains.
 This is the penultimate update for Fortnite Treasure Hunters Mini Season.
 Click Here to Add Beebom as a Trusted Source 
 Add as a preferred source on Google 
 The first major update for Fortnite Treasure Hunters Mini Season, 43.10, goes live later this week, and there’s a lot coming based on early patch notes. With Captains and crews all vying for the power of the Zero Point Sliver, this is an exciting time to be a swashbuckling buccaneer on the Crossbones Isle. If you want to know more, here’s a full breakdown of Fortnite Treasure Hunters Mini Season early patch notes for update 43.10.
 Fortnite Treasure Hunters Update 43.00 Downtime Details
 The Fortnite downtime for the Treasure Hunters Mini Season update 43.10 is expected to begin at 4 AM ET on November 12, 2026 . This is the first major update for the Treasure Hunters Mini Season and introduces new Captains, Map Fragments, Quests, and more.
 The scheduled maintenance should last about 90 minutes, with Fortnite servers coming back online at 5:30 AM ET for everyone . Use this time to take a break from hunting for the elusive Pirate Shop Token in Fortnite . Epic Games will provide an official timeline later this week.
 Fortnite Treasure Hunters Mini Season Early Patch Notes Update 43.10
 New Sprites 
 We know that the latest update, patch 43.10, is going to introduce new Sprites in Fortnite Treasure Hunters . Navigator’s Nosedive Umbrella unlocks after 40 Sprites are mastered, and there are only 34 at the moment. This means more are going to be introduced later this week. 
 Expect to see a few more pirate-themed Sprites added to Treasure Hunters with the latest Fortnite update 43.10 patch. On a side note, if you master seven Sprites, you become eligible to claim the Sprite Mastery Strongbox in Fortnite .
 New Captains and Map Fragments
 Based on the previous patch notes, Epic Games confirmed that New Captains and Map Fragments are going to be added with the next Fortnite update , which is 43.10. Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto arrive on the island this week in Fortnite Treasure Hunters Mini Season.
 Image Credit: Epic Games A new Fortnite Map Fragment will also become available to collect this weekend during Treasure Hours in Fortnite . Epic Games will reveal more information about it in the coming days. 
 Fortnite Loot Pool Changes
 From what we know from the Fortnite early patch notes for update 43.10, three weapons could be added to the Treasure Hunters Mini Season loot pool . These would give players more options to choose from and switch up the meta. Here’s the list of the upcoming weapons:
 Lever Action Shotgun
 Frenzy Auto Shotgun
 Flapjack Rifle
 Image Credit: Epic Games If they aren’t added with this week’s update 43.10 patch, we will definitely see them included towards the end of Fortnite Treasure Hunters Mini Season . Either way, with there being plenty of options to choose from, such as the Gum Gum Fortnite Fruit and others, there’s no shortage of firepower at the moment.
 New Map Changes
 With the arrival of Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto this week, Rubber Resort is going to undergo a few changes during the Fortnite update 43.10 patch. This POI on the Fortnite Treasure Hunters Mini Season map will get a makeover to better suit the upcoming Captains’ colors.
 New Skins + Super Styles
 Lil Uzi Vert, Buggy, and Cap’n Hatsune Miku arrive in the Fortnite Item Shop later this week, once the update patch 43.10 is released. If you’ve managed to get the Pirate Shop Token and it’s active, you can get all the skins for free. If not, you can always redeem a Fortnite V-Bucks Card to get a top-up.
 Image Credit: Epic Games There’s good news for Fortnite Treasure Hunters Battle Pass holders, as Super Styles are coming with the update patch 43.10. EpicTofuChris’s post on TikTok revealed inverted manga-page-inspired Super Styles for Battle Pass skins. Players can unlock them later this month after reaching level 70.
 Fortnite Festival Season 16
 Epic Games has confirmed that Kasane Teto is going to be the next collab for Festival Season 16 in Fortnite Treasure Hunters Mini Season. It, too, is slated to go live with the Fortnite update 43.10 patch on November 12, 2026. Expect to get more details about the Kasane Teto Fortnite Festival soon. 
 New QOL Improvement + Bug Fixes
 Senior Design Director, Ted Timmis, posted on X , revealing that a major QOL improvement is coming with the Fortnite update 43.10. No details have been shared, but he had this to say. “What if I told you that Thursday’s update contains what I believe will be a top 5 goated quality of life improvement that ya’ll will enjoy for the rest of the season?” 
 Image Credit: Beebom The pesky bug that hinders players’ ability to dig up buried Treasure Hunt Chests in Fortnite will also be addressed in the update patch 43.10. It will make landing at the One Piece Pirate Chest in Fortnite more rewarding and less frustrating.
 That’s everything we can tell you about the Fortnite update 43.10 from the early patch notes. We will update this article with more information as and when more details are shared. Until then, you can read all about the best methods to get the Fortnite Pirate Shop Token in Treasure Hunters Mini Season.
 Let us know in the comments below what you are most excited about based on the early patch notes for Fortnite update 43.10.
